## What & why

Describe the change and the problem it solves. Link the related issue if
there is one (e.g. `Fixes #12`).

## How was this tested?

Describe how you verified the change (manual steps in the widget/console,
what you checked, on which browsers if UI is involved).

## Checklist

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] No secrets, connection strings, or API keys in the diff
- [ ] `public/relay.js` changes (if any) are dependency-free ES5
- [ ] PR is focused on a single fix/feature
